# Contributor License Agreement (CLA) · Tamandua

Version 1.0 · September 23, 2026

*This agreement is published in English and in Spanish ([CLA.es.md](CLA.es.md)). Both versions are equally authoritative and express the same agreement; you may read and sign either one. If they ever differ, the Spanish version prevails.*

Thank you for contributing. This agreement clarifies the rights in what you contribute, so that the project can remain free software and, at the same time, sustain itself through a possible commercial edition. **You keep the copyright in your contribution**: you do not assign it to us; you grant us a broad license to use it.

You sign it only once, by commenting on your first pull request as the bot instructs.

## 1. Definitions

- **"Owner"**: whoever maintains the Tamandua project, currently the person who controls the GitHub account [BrayansStivens](https://github.com/BrayansStivens), and any successor or assignee under section 8.
- **"You"**: the individual who accepts this agreement or, if you contribute on behalf of an organization, that organization.
- **"Contribution"**: any work (code, documentation, rules, designs or other material) that you submit to the Owner for inclusion in the project, by pull request, issue, patch or any other means, unless you clearly mark it in writing as "Not a Contribution".
- **"Project"**: the Tamandua software (formerly called AppSec Agent; repository `Tamandua-AppSec`, formerly `appsec-agent`) and its documentation, in any version or edition.

## 2. Copyright license

You grant the Owner and recipients of software distributed by the Owner a **perpetual, worldwide, non-exclusive, no-charge, royalty-free and irrevocable** license to reproduce, prepare derivative works of, publicly display, publicly perform, sublicense and distribute your Contribution and such derivative works.

This expressly includes the right to distribute it **under any license**, whether free (such as the AGPL-3.0) or commercial or proprietary.

## 3. Patent license

You grant the Owner and recipients of software distributed by the Owner a **perpetual, worldwide, non-exclusive, no-charge, royalty-free and irrevocable** patent license, except as stated below. It covers making, having made, using, offering, selling, importing and otherwise transferring your Contribution, alone or in combination with the Project.

It extends only to the patent claims that you are able to license and that are necessarily infringed by your Contribution or by its combination with the Project. If anyone institutes patent litigation alleging that your Contribution or the Project infringes a patent, the patent licenses granted to that party under this agreement terminate as of the date the litigation is filed.

## 4. Owner's commitment

As long as a free edition of the Project exists, your Contribution will remain available in it under the AGPL-3.0 or another license approved by the Open Source Initiative. A commercial edition cannot remove your Contribution from the free edition.

The Owner is not obligated to include or use your Contribution.

## 5. Your representations

You represent that:

1. You are entitled to grant these licenses. If your employer or another person has rights in what you create, you have obtained their permission to contribute under these terms, or they have waived those rights for this Contribution.
2. Your Contribution is your own original work. If it includes third-party material, you identify it in the Contribution itself, with its authorship and license, and that license allows it to be included in the Project.
3. To the best of your knowledge, your Contribution does not infringe any third-party rights.
4. Your Contribution contains no secrets, credentials or personal data of third parties.

## 6. No warranty

Except for what you represent in section 5, you provide your Contribution "as is", without warranties or conditions of any kind, express or implied. You are not obligated to provide support for it.

## 7. Notices

If any of your representations ceases to be accurate, you will notify the Owner through the repository's private vulnerability reporting or by opening an issue.

## 8. Assignment

The Owner may assign this agreement and the rights it grants the Owner to a successor, for example a company formed to maintain the Project. The commitment in section 4 binds that successor equally.

## 9. How to sign

On your first pull request, the *CLA* workflow (`.github/workflows/cla.yml`) will ask you to comment exactly:

> I have read the Tamandua CLA and I accept it

(or its Spanish equivalent, «He leído el CLA de Tamandua y lo acepto»). Your GitHub username, the date and the pull request are recorded in the `cla-signatures` branch of this repository. The signature covers all your future contributions under this version of the agreement.
